faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

faqs.question: How much does Botox cost?
faqs.answer: Botox treatments start from £200. The final price depends on the number of areas treated. We recommend a free consultation to get a personalised quote.

faqs.question: How much do fillers cost?
faqs.answer: Dermal fillers start from £250. Pricing varies depending on the type of filler and the area being treated. A free consultation can help you understand the exact cost for your goals.

faqs.question: Is the consultation free?
faqs.answer: Yes! Initial consultations are completely free of charge. We recommend booking one before your first treatment so we can assess your suitability and discuss your goals.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book via WhatsApp or through our website at www.bloomaesthetics.co.uk. We require at least 24 hours notice for any cancellations or rescheduling.

faqs.question: How long does Botox last?
faqs.answer: Results from Botox are typically visible within 3–5 days and last around 3–4 months on average. Maintenance appointments are recommended to sustain results.

faqs.question: How long do fillers last?
faqs.answer: Dermal filler results are immediate and typically last between 6–12 months, depending on the area treated and the product used.

faqs.question: How long does a treatment take?
faqs.answer: A Botox session typically takes around 30 minutes. Dermal filler treatments take approximately 45 minutes. Initial consultations are around 20 minutes.
